posts.en:
dsh-memento is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection; every write passes the approval gate and stays reconstructable from the session log.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c1a2a43a57a09e393179.html
